en.name: XO sauce
en.summary: XO sauce is dried scallop, dried shrimp and cured ham held under oil with chilli and garlic. A commercial jar keeps about 18–24 months unopened and about 2–3 months refrigerated after opening. A homemade batch is a different thing entirely: 4 days in the fridge, or about 3 months frozen.
en.pantry: Unopened commercial jars keep on the shelf to the printed date, about 18–24 months from purchase, in a cool dark cupboard. Once opened, commercial XO sauce goes in the fridge — it is mostly dried seafood and cured ham held under oil, and the oil is what keeps air off it, not a preservative in itself. Do not keep a jar with a domed lid or a broken seal, and never leave a homemade batch at room temperature at all.
en.fridge: Two different products, two different answers. A commercial jar keeps about 2–3 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below: keep the solids submerged under the oil layer, use a clean dry spoon, and top up with a little neutral oil if the surface is exposed. Homemade XO sauce is fresh garlic, shallot and chilli suspended in oil, which is exactly the low-acid-produce-under-oil situation that carries a botulism risk — the rule for garlic in oil applies, so refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or lower for no more than 4 days, or freeze it for longer. Frying the aromatics until they are genuinely dry and crisp reduces but does not eliminate the risk.
en.freezer: Homemade XO sauce freezes well in a small jar or an ice-cube tray at −18 °C (0 °F), and about 3 months is a fair limit — garlic in oil may be frozen for long-term storage for up to several months. This is the right answer for a batch you cannot finish in a few days. A commercial jar does not need freezing; the fridge already gives it months, and freezing would separate the oil.
en.thawing: Thaw a frozen cube in the fridge and use it within a few days, or spoon it straight into a hot wok. Never thaw XO sauce at room temperature — that returns it to exactly the conditions you froze it to avoid.
spoilage: Mould on the surface or on solids standing above the oil
Gas, bubbling or a bulging jar — discard without tasting
A rancid, crayon-like or off-fishy smell from the oil or the dried seafood
A fermented or yeasty smell instead of a deep savoury, briny one
tips: Keep the solids pressed under the oil and top up with neutral oil if they are exposed.
Use a dry spoon every time; water in the jar is what starts mould.
Freeze a homemade batch in cubes on the day you make it.
Botulinum toxin cannot be seen, smelled or tasted, so never judge an oil-covered homemade sauce by inspection.

faq.q: How long does XO sauce last once opened?
faq.a: A commercial jar keeps about 2–3 months refrigerated at 4 °C or below, with the solids under the oil. Homemade is only 4 days.
Yes — a homemade batch freezes well for about 3 months at −18 °C, in a small jar or ice-cube tray.

faq.q: How long does an unopened jar of XO sauce keep?
faq.a: About 18–24 months in a cool dark cupboard, to the printed date.

faq.q: Why is homemade XO sauce so much shorter-lived?
faq.a: It contains fresh garlic, shallot and chilli under oil — low-acid produce in an oxygen-free environment, which is the classic botulism setting. Keep it cold and use it within days, or freeze it.

zh.name: XO 醬
zh.summary: XO 醬是把干貝、蝦米和金華火腿浸在油裡，加上辣椒和蒜頭做成的醬。市售罐裝未開封大約 18～24 個月，開封後冷藏大約 2～3 個月。自製的則完全是另一回事：冷藏 4 天，或冷凍大約 3 個月。
zh.pantry: 未開封的市售罐裝放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃，到標示日期為止，從購買日起算大約 18～24 個月。一旦開封，市售 XO 醬就要進冰箱——它主要是浸在油下的乾貨海鮮和火腿，而油的作用是隔絕空氣，本身並不是防腐劑。蓋子鼓起或封口破損的罐子不要留，自製的更是絕對不能放在室溫。
zh.fridge: 兩種不同的產品，兩個不同的答案。市售罐裝放 4 °C 以下大約 2～3 個月：讓固形物保持在油層以下，使用乾淨乾燥的湯匙，表面露出來就補一點中性油。自製 XO 醬是新鮮蒜、紅蔥和辣椒懸浮在油裡，正是帶有肉毒桿菌風險的「低酸性食材泡油」情境——適用蒜頭泡油的規則：放 4 °C 以下冷藏，最多 4 天，要更久就冷凍。把辛香料炸到真正乾脆能降低風險，但不能消除風險。
zh.freezer: 自製 XO 醬很適合用小罐或製冰盒在 −18 °C 冷凍，大約 3 個月是合理上限——蒜頭泡油可以冷凍長期保存數個月。對幾天內吃不完的一批來說，這才是正確答案。市售罐裝則不需要冷凍；冷藏本來就有好幾個月，冷凍反而會讓油分離。
zh.thawing: 冷凍的醬塊請放冷藏解凍並在幾天內用完，或直接挖進熱鍋。XO 醬絕對不要放室溫解凍——那等於把它送回你當初冷凍要避開的環境。
spoilage: 醬面或露出油面的固形物長霉
產氣、冒泡或罐子鼓起——不要試吃，直接丟掉
油或乾貨發出油耗味、蠟筆味或不對勁的腥味
聞起來有發酵味或酵母味，而不是深沉的鹹鮮海味
tips: 讓固形物壓在油面以下，露出來就補一點中性油。
每次都用乾燥的湯匙；罐子裡有水就是發霉的起點。
自製的請在製作當天就分成小塊冷凍。
肉毒桿菌毒素看不到、聞不到、嚐不出來，所以油封的自製醬絕不能靠外觀判斷。

faq.q: XO 醬開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 市售罐裝放 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 2～3 個月，並讓固形物泡在油裡。自製的只有 4 天。
可以——自製的用小罐或製冰盒在 −18 °C 冷凍大約 3 個月，效果很好。

faq.q: 未開封的 XO 醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 18～24 個月，以標示日期為準。

faq.q: 自製 XO 醬為什麼短這麼多？
faq.a: 它含新鮮蒜、紅蔥和辣椒，又浸在油裡——低酸性食材處在無氧環境，正是肉毒桿菌的典型條件。請保持低溫、幾天內用完，或冷凍。
